title: Training start and extended boundary preserved in Freestyle
summary: The authored Training venue adapter keeps the source TOY start and uses the Training-specific extended boundary in Freestyle. A settled 960×600 Chromium host capture shows the rider grounded at 00 mph on the original course.
details: Source instruction tracing ties Training mode 6 to margin −1000 independently of CrowdPresent; the browser adapter preserves that course policy rather than applying the ordinary Freestyle inset.

On the original start (124.06978, 89.74450, 636.56952), 180 no-input steps remained grounded at 0.000033 ft/s; another 180 idle steps after reset remained at 0.000042 ft/s. Actual 390 px touch input moved the ATV, six hay approaches contacted wheels and body, and a position beyond 3768 still triggered the extended boundary.

The inspected host-only Chromium capture uses the natural source start and original hosted runtime content, with no camera or teleport hook. It is an authored browser view, not original menu artwork or a physical-device capture.
limitation: This does not recover Training objectives, lesson callbacks, or a full original Training replay. Boundary flight remains active beyond the source-verified extended thresholds; all evidence is host-only.
caption: Training Course at its source start in an authored 960×600 Chromium host capture after 186 simulation steps; the rider is grounded at 00 mph. No physical phone or original menu artwork is implied.
